name: Add Cats
description: Resident pixel cats that appear on tagged pages, stay, and run to wherever visitors click. Bundled public-domain Neko skins plus bring-your-own sprite sheets.
author: Paolo Gabriel

settings.name: Enabled
settings.description: Master toggle. Cats appear only on pages tagged with the note flag, and only while this is on.

settings.name: Resident cat count
settings.description: Number of cats that appear on a tagged page. Clamped 1 to 5.

settings.name: Sprite size
settings.description: Rendered pixel size of each cat sprite. 16 to 64, default 32.

settings.name: Click behavior
settings.description: clicked: nearest cat walks to the click. stampede: all cats run to the click at their own speed.

settings.name: Skin
settings.description: Skin id, or random to mix bundled and configured skins across the resident cats.

settings.name: Background key color
settings.description: Optional hex color (e.g. #00AEF0) removed from sprite sheets that use a flat background instead of transparency. Leave empty for sheets that already have a transparent background.

settings.name: Fur color
settings.description: Optional hex color applied to the cat frames, e.g. #8b6bd6. Works best on the near-white classic sheets: the outline, shading and anti-aliasing are preserved and only the hue changes. Very dark colors are lifted slightly so the cat stays readable against its outline. Leave empty to draw the sheet as it is.

settings.name: Per-skin fur colors
settings.description: Optional JSON map of skin id to hex color, e.g. {"greta":"#a06cd5"}. Overrides the tint setting for that skin, so two pinned cats can wear different colors.

settings.name: Sprite sheets
settings.description: Bring-your-own sprite sheets. Map a skin id to an absolute HTTP(S) URL or site-root-relative path of a PNG sprite sheet. Example {"calico":"/nekos/calico.png"}. Share the id via the skin setting. Sheets may use the classic Neko layout (263x197) or the oneko layout (256x128); both are auto-detected. Public-domain classic skins: https://bomvel.neocities.org/neko/

settings.name: Paw prints
settings.description: Leave a fading trail of paw prints behind a running cat. Prints come from the cat's own sheet when it has a mark row (the classic 263x197 layout, row 4) and from the bundled classic sheet otherwise, so brought-your-own oneko sheets get a trail too. Never drawn when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

settings.name: Paw print fade
settings.description: Seconds a paw print takes to fade out before it is removed. Clamped 1 to 30.

settings.name: Per-skin speed
settings.description: Optional walk speed in pixels per step per skin. Map a skin id to a number, e.g. {"nigel":13}. Cats without an entry move at a random 5-14 px speed.
